title: Playing snare and bass drum in the street: keeping steady time
summary: Rene says he mostly played snare and sometimes bass. He prided himself on steady time and not showing off.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Did you play snare drum or bass drum mostly in the street?

Well I played mostly snare drum. I used to play bass drum sometimes. Just like when they couldn't get a bass drum player, well I'd play bass drum. They wanted me to stay on bass drum, you know, on account of time, you know. I never was a fella that liked to show off. I was time conscious. That was me, that's the sort of drum I was, time conscious. I always just believed to try to get a fella that good time and support him, you see. A fella can produce better when he got good time, you see. But if you got a fella making things off, throwing off a balance like that, when he get ready to execute, then you knock him off. Cause see a lot of time when you're making those things, you're playing ad lib, you see. Ad lib means you're playing a note set time, you're playing a chord in slow and fast. But now I was just believing all that straight time. See. I didn't try to make no run on the bass drum, I just kept that solid lick, you know. Sometimes I'd give double time. When I give double time, I get to just like boom, I keep them going. I kept them rocking. But you wouldn't give them boom,
No double rap stuff or anything like that.

Well you see that, that don't blow, Stacey. See, if that fella got a straight rhythm, he's playing some of the cars a straight rhythm, and he come in there on a different rhythm. Especially him, the band that played the bass drum, he's time people. He's supposed to come in there, he's a single, one, two, one, two, three, four, one, two, oh he's a one, two, three, four, that's him, see. But if he come in there, you see, he'd throw the time off, see. Stair drum, he can make different stuff, but that bass drum got a whole lot of time.
